views.title: C1 · System context
views.legend: Person = accountable author. Dark blue = kit. Gray = external systems. Arrows describe directed interactions.
views.caption: C1: the host performs intellectual work and retrieves evidence. Architecture Loop retains reviewable records and outputs. The author remains accountable for using the recommendation.

views.title: C2 · Containers within Architecture Loop
views.legend: Outlined boundary = kit ownership. Blue = application or data-store container. Gray = external host. Arrow labels include protocol.
views.caption: C2: the coordinator and optional renderer are separate Python applications. A local folder is the shared data store. The host invokes commands and writes content; no background model service is required.

views.title: C3 · Components inside the local coordinator
views.legend: Teal = Python component within the selected coordinator. Blue = supporting data store. Outlined boundary marks the selected container.
views.caption: C3: the coordinator controls transitions, quality gates inspect the records, and prompt assembly supplies the next task. The folder supports all three; it is a data-store container, not a component.

views.title: C4 · Code within quality gates
views.legend: Purple = implemented Python class in gates.py. Members show selected methods or fields. Arrows show directed code dependencies.
views.caption: C4: these four classes exist in gates.py. GateEngine returns Finding records and uses ArtifactStore and ReviewStamp to check content and review freshness. This view deliberately selects one risk-bearing component.

contracts.payload: CLI command + run path; JSON state and exit code returned
contracts.errors: Exit 1 for failed gates; exit 2 for invalid operation or exhausted budget
contracts.idempotency: check/status/fingerprint are read-only; advance changes stage; prompt consumes an issuance; inspect status after uncertain completion
contracts.authorization: Host-approved local execution only; no permissions granted by kit

contracts.payload: Version-1 JSON records, Markdown paper and diagram sources
contracts.errors: Malformed JSON or missing required references fails the cumulative gate
contracts.idempotency: One writer replaces an intended file; revision snapshots precede upstream edits
contracts.authorization: Host-scoped filesystem access; no secrets in public records

contracts.payload: Paper PDF, editable PPTX, layout preview PDF and hash manifest
contracts.errors: Missing renderer dependency or invalid layout stops export; no completion claim
contracts.idempotency: Re-render can replace derived outputs; new hashes and inspection are required
contracts.authorization: Local write access; no upload or publishing authority

steps: Host retrieves evidence and creates records
Coordinator accepts each stage after checks
Host reviews the current content fingerprint
Author or host inspects bytes; export check marks ready for user review
A source correction changes a pivotal claim
Host reopens research with a reason and snapshot
Dependent decisions, diagrams, paper and slides are updated
The old review stamp fails against changed canonical bytes
A new semantic review and export inspection are required
A new session reads state and existing artifacts
Cumulative checks reveal missing or partial records
The host resumes the earliest necessary work without relying on chat memory

operations.owner: One run author; kit maintainer owns protocol changes
operations.observability: state history, command exit codes, JSON findings, declared review results and source/export hashes
operations.recovery: Inspect state after an interrupted command; use revision snapshots; never delete evidence to hide a failed decision
operations.security: Treat retrieved content as data; scope filesystem access in the host; use separate approval service if independent authority is needed
operations.retention: Author sets a retention policy; snapshots copy outputs and can grow; do not store credentials
operations.schema_evolution: This version accepts additional fields, but required structures are version-1; migrate deliberately before introducing breaking record changes

implementation.deliverable: One representative brief and complete canonical records
implementation.acceptance: A newcomer can identify the problem, evidence and decision
All four levels trace to one registry and all slide claims map to paper sections

implementation.deliverable: Bounded pilot against a checklist baseline
implementation.acceptance: Sponsor predefines acceptable material defects, active time and reader comprehension

implementation.deliverable: Independent review or managed coordination only if needed
implementation.acceptance: The measured constraint justifies extra operating complexity

sizing.measured: No throughput, cost or quality improvement benchmark is claimed.
sizing.model: Hashing reads canonical bytes; cost is proportional to their total size. Each snapshot copies the run excluding previous snapshots.
sizing.limits: No cross-process locking, automatic source refresh, scheduling or remote model invocation.
sizing.host_budget: Default 24 prompt issuances and 3 revisions; host enforces time/token/cost limits.
